extract: The Viśuddhaprabhā Dhāraṇī, also known by its full title Raśmi-vimala-viśuddhaprabhā-dhāraṇī, is a Buddhist ritual text belonging to the dhāraṇī genre of protective and transformative formulas. This text is preserved in multiple versions and sutras within the Tibetan Kanjur and Chinese Buddhist canons. The dhāraṇī centers on the worship of Amitāyuṣ and the invocation of Viśuddhaprabhā, a goddess which personifies Ami
